sourceNotes.note: Giants RB Eric Gray signed to practice squad; Skattebo worked on the side with trainer (hamstring); Tracy on IR.
Reported Skattebo worked on the side with trainer during media portion of practice.

items.text: RB Eric Gray is being signed to the practice squad, per source. Giants shorthanded on RBs with Tyrone Tracy on IR and Cam Skattebo working on the side.
items.why: Skattebo working on the side with trainer after hamstring injury; Gray signed to PS amid depth shortage with Tracy on IR.
items.implication: Giants RB depth is thin. Skattebo may be limited or questionable; if he misses time, other backs could see more work. Gray is on practice squad and not yet elevated.
items.opportunity: Watch for Giants RB role changes or elevations; speculative interest in available depth if Skattebo is out.
